newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hackman up sharply on Hadwaco's prospects.
newsitem.headline: Hackman up sharply on Hadwaco's prospects.

text.p: Finnish diversified group Oy Hackman Ab rose sharply in active trade on Thursday as investors saw increased value in its environmental technology Hadwaco unit, brokers said.
Hackman said on Tuesday that Hadwaco had sealed a marketing partnership agreement with U.S. Filter Corporation.
At 1530/1230 GMT, Hackman traded at 149.00 markka up eight or almost six percent. Turnover was healthy for Hackaman at 5.5 million.
"The partnership deal really boosted Hadwaco's value," one broker said.
Brokers also said that investors were pleased with Hackman's new management. Tapio Hintikka was recruited from Nokia to become CEO from the start of this year.
